name: nginx-multisite
description: Configures Nginx as a reverse proxy and web server for three SSL-enabled virtual hosts, including site content, security hardening, firewall and Fail2ban configuration, SSH settings, and self-signed certificate generation.

name: cache
description: Installs and enables Memcached and Redis, configures Redis authentication and service settings, and applies platform-specific Redis runtime configuration adjustments.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Installs Python and PostgreSQL dependencies, deploys the FastAPI tutorial application, provisions its database and virtual environment, and runs it as a systemd service on port 8000.
